name: golden_set_geographic
purpose: Hand-marked correct publication zones for the geography prompt. Until this existed there was no way to know whether the geographic resolver worked before publishing — the weekly 20-item sample only starts after go-live.
source: sample_107_direct_urls.json, Apify direct-URL run of 19 August 2026
how_to_use: Run the full chain per PROMPT_GEO_BLOCK.md: guards tier A, venue registry, guards tier B, alias lookup, model.
Compare publication_zone and geo_basis against the expected values.
Items with confidence = 'verify' need a local check of the zone boundary before they are scored. They are included because they are the realistic hard cases, not because the answer is settled.

expected_publication_zone = null means EMPTY is the correct answer. Getting these right matters more than the positives: a wrong zone on an out-of-Rome event publishes a foreign event on a Roman page and nothing blocks it.

pass_threshold.zone: at least 24 of 27 high-confidence in-Rome items
pass_threshold.empties: 9 of 9. An empty that should be empty is not optional — this is the whole reason invariant I3 exists.
pass_threshold.note: Below 95% on high-confidence explicit_address items, PROMPT_GEO_BLOCK.md says to promote the double pass to 'always'. This file is how that trigger becomes measurable before go-live rather than after.

trap_cases.trap: 'Eur Montagnola' in the address. Correct zone is Montagnola. A substring match on 'EUR' gets it wrong.
The meeting point is in Rome, the event is not. Tests whether the model resolves the venue or the event.
